stem: Rohan's classmate offers him a cigarette after school in a park in Jaipur and says, 'Trying it once will do no harm.' What should Rohan do?

options.text: Try it once, because one cigarette cannot cause any harm.
Try it only if he has no breathing difficulty.
Refuse it from the first offer, because tobacco is harmful and addictive.
Refuse it only if it is an illegal drug, and accept it otherwise.

teacher.key_rationale: Tobacco, gutka, cigarettes, beedi, alcohol, and illegal drugs are harmful and addictive, so they must be refused from the first offer and every time; saying no and seeking help from trusted adults protects health. Option C states this correct decision. A and B wrongly treat a single try as safe, and D wrongly restricts refusal to illegal drugs.
